name: DeletePlaybook

parameters.help_en:
The language of the request and response. Valid values:

zh (default): Chinese.

en: English
parameters.help_zh:
请求和接收消息的语言类型。取值：

zh（默认）：中文。

en：英文
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en: The ID of the user for whom the administrator switches to a member perspective
parameters.help_zh: 管理员切换成其他成员视角的用户ID
parameters.name: role_for

parameters.help_en: The UUID of the playbook. Only user-type (custom) playbooks can be deleted. Preset (system-predefined) playbooks cannot be deleted. You can call ListPlaybooks with PlaybookType set to user to obtain the list of deletable playbooks
parameters.help_zh: 剧本的UUID。仅user类型（自定义）剧本可删除，preset（系统预置）剧本不可删除；可通过ListPlaybooks(PlaybookType=user)获取可删除剧本列表
parameters.name: playbook_uuid

RequestId.description_en: The ID of the request. The ID is a unique identifier that Alibaba Cloud generates for the request. You can use the ID to troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题
